chitchat: runs a white glove along a broken rail and studies the dust with quiet disappointment.
"The Architect maintains. We merely file the paperwork."
"This district is under Custodial care. Kindly do not deface the ruins."
description: Deacon Ferrin tends the ruins of Old Coldwater the way a verger tends a cathedral — reverently, and with a clipboard. He believes the Architect maintains all things and that the Custodians are simply its middle management. He will explain this to you at length, whether or not you asked.

clothing_layers: a hi-vis vestment worn over a charcoal three-piece suit
a starched white shirt with a fraying collar

name: Deacon Aldous Ferrin
